title: Ordivon Game Domain Package Graph R1
purpose: Machine-readable Lego graph of stable Game semantics, development views, reusable mechanics/compositions, Game-owned adapters, Skills and horizontal service dependencies. It projects existing authority; it does not create task priority, product selection, stage admission or dynamic standing.

constraints.statement: Dynamic Task, Goal, checkpoint and Board standing is re-entered through Host and the owning domain; this architecture graph cannot mint current work standing, priority or completion.
Provider cognition produces candidate decisions only; Game alone validates identity, legality, freshness and admission before any authoritative World consequence.
Model or Agent prose cannot directly mutate authoritative World state; it must cross Game-owned action/candidate admission and deterministic or explicitly authorized consequence resolution.

Product-specific mechanics are not promoted into Big Game shared code merely because several files need a home; cross-game promotion requires real independent consumers and evidence that a mature external owner cannot satisfy the mechanical responsibility.

A new generic-seeming Game infrastructure mechanism is admitted only after the exact mature external mechanism is tested, its failure condition is observed, the lost Game-specific invariant is named, and a thinner profile or adapter is insufficient.

Mechanical, simulation, synthetic-player and automated evaluation evidence can establish mechanics, reachability, robustness or causal differences, but cannot by identity establish Human enjoyment, comprehension, preference, retention or market response.

Repository typechecks and automated tests establish bounded implementation health only; passing them does not establish product selection, G-stage admission, Human Player Value, market demand or release authority.

E01, E02 and E03 KEEP standing is mechanical-scope only: it proves the exact tested causal or transfer property and does not imply enjoyment, learning, mastery, retention, market value, product selection or G0 admission.

High-quality media, successful native rendering, build reproducibility or Artifact acceptance can prove expression and delivery properties but cannot substitute for gameplay causality or Human Player Value evidence.

This graph intentionally records stable architecture and source refs, not live Task state, current provider health, installed-tool health or latest experiment verdicts; those facts require owner-native re-entry when used.

Historical evidence and Board records remain provenance, but any action-changing claim about current code, provider availability, task standing or accepted evidence must bind the exact current owner source or observation rather than infer from an older record.
Provider credentials or technical capability do not constitute user effect authority, release approval, product authority or permission to perform an external write.

Fixture Agents, policy Agents, model trajectories and synthetic subjects cannot be relabeled as Human participant evidence when the target claim concerns Human experience, interpretation, preference or behaviour.

Host Task, checkpoint or Board persistence is continuity evidence and navigation; it does not replace Game World truth, Game product authority, Research admissibility or owner-native semantic verification.

A screenshot, render, file existence, provider completion or format-valid artifact cannot by itself prove that authoritative gameplay semantics, causality or requested editable structure were preserved.

A horizontal ownership boundary reopens only when a real Game consumer cannot preserve a necessary Game-specific invariant through the current owner, profile or thin adapter; convenience or namespace preference is insufficient.
Godot is a current proven production substrate, not Game semantic authority; Unity, Unreal, Roblox or later engines remain replaceable choices when a concrete product and evidence justify them.

GPT, Claude, Hermes, a local model, deterministic fixture or scripted policy may realize cognition when admitted; provider replacement must preserve the Game-facing decision contract rather than becoming Game architecture.
Agent Skills are advisory procedural packages selected by client/runtime policy; installing, admitting or exposing a Skill does not transfer Game semantic ownership or create product-stage authority.

Evidence(A) + Evidence(B) does not by itself establish Evidence(A+B): component evidence never automatically becomes composition evidence; every novel combination may create emergent behavior and needs evidence matched to the composition claim.

Mechanical survival, causal evidence, or successful recombination does not by itself select a product or establish Human Player Value; exploration stays open while product and Human claims remain evidence-bounded.

evidenceDischargeRules.note: Human evidence can satisfy a Human-target evidence gate for the studied claim; the evidence-class distinction itself remains true.
Fresh owner-native standing permits action to proceed without converting this graph into a live registry.
Exact current revision or observation satisfies the re-entry requirement for that owner only.
Observed mismatch is necessary evidence but local extension still requires named invariant loss and authority adjudication.
A second independent consumer is minimum evidence, not automatic promotion; the shared-owner decision remains explicit.
Substitution failure permits boundary review but does not move ownership on its own.
Native-consumer success is stronger artifact evidence but semantic correctness still requires the relevant Game/domain verification.
Explicit effect authority may authorize the action, but it proves that authority separately rather than making credentials equivalent to authority.
Human evidence may justify reviewing the mechanical-only claim ceiling for a specific target claim; it does not auto-expand all mechanic claims.
Human response evidence can support a broader expression/feel claim only after target-variable and population review.

evidenceDischargeRules.authorityAfterEvidence: Game claim owner + Research evidence owner
evidenceDischargeRules.note: Component-level mechanical evidence remains useful provenance but does not establish the behavior or value of the combined composition.
Human evidence can support a specific Player Value review but does not automatically select a product.

authorityAdjudicationRules.decision: Choose external-owner extension, thin Game profile/adapter, or a justified ownership-boundary reopen while preserving the named Game invariant.

Decide whether repeated implementation structure should remain product-local, become a thin shared adapter/profile, or move to another owner. This is code/ownership organization only and never decides whether a mechanic combination may be explored.
Admit provider replacement only through a contract that preserves candidate-only cognition and Game-owned action/consequence authority.

decisionOperations.description: Check whether evidence supports a specific Human experience/interpretation/preference/behaviour claim without restricting what may be built or combined.
Check an external effect authority boundary; this never restricts creative exploration inside the repository.
Check provider replacement authority for runtime-agent integrations without turning provider capability into Game World authority.

creativePolicy.creativeCombinationRule: Any game type, mechanic, rule, content system, control scheme, representation or interaction may be combined experimentally unless a separate real-world safety/authority boundary applies.
creativePolicy.unknownRule: Unknown or unmodeled creative structure is an exploration signal, not a rejection signal.
hardBoundaries: historical standing does not become current standing

mechanismCombinationPatterns.hypothesis: Costly commitment plus incomplete information plus rapid reset may make tactical mistakes legible and support accumulated skill.
mechanismCombinationPatterns.falsifier: Remove lethal commitment or information scarcity; if positioning, information-seeking and tension barely change, transfer is weak.

mechanismCombinationPatterns.hypothesis: Role interdependence plus delayed power and shared objectives may turn local actions into delayed collective consequences.
mechanismCombinationPatterns.falsifier: If local output can be maximized independently and coordination/resource timing adds little, the pattern is weak.

mechanismCombinationPatterns.hypothesis: Survival, uncertainty and spatial convergence may repeatedly create route-versus-engagement decisions; ecosystem causality remains separate.
mechanismCombinationPatterns.falsifier: Compare with static respawn arena; if routes, engagement and resource timing barely change, the BR transfer is weak.

mechanismCombinationPatterns.hypothesis: A small composable transformation grammar may let players turn self-authored intentions into persistent world state.
mechanismCombinationPatterns.falsifier: If players do not form self-authored spatial intentions or persistence does not affect later choices, the authorship claim is weak.

mechanismCombinationPatterns.hypothesis: Walking, driving, combat and world response may feel like one possibility space when actions cross subsystem boundaries.
mechanismCombinationPatterns.falsifier: If verbs remain isolated minigames and players rarely improvise cross-system plans, the transfer is weak.

mechanismCombinationPatterns.hypothesis: Commitment windows and route freedom may combine skill learning with strategic avoidance/return-later choices.
mechanismCombinationPatterns.falsifier: If retries do not change anticipation/timing or route choice does not change responses to difficulty, the transfers weaken.

mechanismCombinationPatterns.hypothesis: Agency may become credible when mechanically different solutions persist and are later acknowledged by characters/world state.
mechanismCombinationPatterns.falsifier: If approaches feel cosmetically equivalent or acknowledgement does not alter interpretation, the pattern is weak.

mechanismCombinationPatterns.hypothesis: Automation may become valuable when prior manual work turns into persistent capability and bottlenecks provoke architectural redesign.
mechanismCombinationPatterns.falsifier: If automation does not shift cognition toward diagnosis/architecture or bottlenecks stay opaque, leverage transfer is weak.

mechanismCombinationPatterns.hypothesis: Stable driving mastery may coexist with comeback volatility, broadening social competition without deleting skill.
mechanismCombinationPatterns.falsifier: If items only add noise without changing comeback probability, tactical risk or rematch behavior, the pattern is weak.

mechanismCombinationPatterns.hypothesis: Persistent decoration and routine may build place attachment while real-time change creates a gentle return promise.
mechanismCombinationPatterns.falsifier: If players do not develop place ownership/routine or return intent is only checklist completion, the pattern is weak.

mechanismCombinationPatterns.hypothesis: A tiny action vocabulary may stay strategically variable when goals, blockers and scarcity repeatedly change local move value.
mechanismCombinationPatterns.falsifier: If goals/blockers do not materially alter move evaluation or retry behavior, the pattern is weak.

mechanismCombinationPatterns.hypothesis: Directional whole-arm action plus immediate multimodal feedback may tightly bind rhythm prediction to motor learning.
mechanismCombinationPatterns.falsifier: Compare with matched non-spatial rhythm control; if anticipation, motor learning or replay intent do not change, transfer is weak.

mechanismExperienceLibrary.purpose: Fine-grained source-grounded mechanism interactions, tensions, inversions, substitutions, failure modes, production responses and cheap falsifiers. Kept external to the domain graph so accumulated experience does not become a closed ontology.
